repo.name: nestjs-realworld-example-app
repo.note: NestJS + TypeORM implementation of the RealWorld spec (~35 TS files: articles, comments, profiles, follows, tags, JWT auth) - real service/repository layering and barrel dto/index.ts files, chosen per plan §12 for import density (not JS, not a huge monorepo).

protocol.note: Fresh session per run (fresh --session-id, no --continue/--resume); baseline and assisted for a task never share a session (plan §8/B).

tasks.prompt: How does user login work in this codebase? Name the specific file and function that handles a login request.

oracle.description: UserController.login() (src/user/user.controller.ts) handles POST users/login; it calls UserService.findOne() to verify credentials and UserService.generateJWT() to issue the token (both in src/user/user.service.ts).

tasks.prompt: Where is UserService used across the codebase?

oracle.description: Every file that imports/injects UserService, besides its own declaration.

tasks.prompt: What files would be affected if I changed the UserEntity class?

oracle.description: Every file that imports UserEntity, besides its own declaration file.

tasks.prompt: Where is CreateArticleDto actually defined, and where is it used? Note it's imported from a barrel file.

oracle.description: Really declared in src/article/dto/create-article.dto.ts, re-exported through the barrel src/article/dto/index.ts, and used in article.controller.ts (create/update handlers) and article.service.ts (create()).

tasks.prompt: Is there an import dependency path from ArticleService to UserEntity? If so, what is it?

oracle.description: Yes, direct: src/article/article.service.ts imports UserEntity straight from src/user/user.entity.ts (one hop, no intermediate file).

tasks.prompt: What does src/article/article.module.ts import, and what imports it?

oracle.description: Imports: article.controller.ts, article.entity.ts, comment.entity.ts, ../user/user.entity.ts, ../profile/follows.entity.ts, article.service.ts, ../user/auth.middleware.ts, ../user/user.module.ts (plus @nestjs/* packages). Imported by: src/app.module.ts.
